org.mobsimlab.aerial-lift.Gondolas and aerial tramways: click stat: Gondola da motocin waya masu kai-da-kawowa: danna tashoshi, hasumiyoyi suna biyowa.
org.mobsimlab.aerial-lift.Monocable detachable gondola (MGD): Gondola mai waya ɗaya mai cirewa (MGD)
org.mobsimlab.aerial-lift.Urban ropeways: continuous gondolas (MGD: Motocin waya na birni: gondola masu tafiya ba tsayawa (MGD, 2S, 3S, funitel, masu bugawa) da motocin waya masu kai-da-kawowa, ana zana su da kayan aikin tazarori madaidaita (ADR-0037).

org.mobsimlab.cargo-bike.How far an electric cargo tricycle gets: Yadda keken kaya mai ƙafa uku na lantarki zai je ya dawo da cajin batir ɗaya, a kan tuddai yana fifita hanyoyin keke, da abin da yake tanadi idan aka kwatanta da mota (saye, mai, haraji, inshora, ajiye mota, gyara), a cikin shafinsa na musamman.
org.mobsimlab.cargo-bike.Round trip from a start point to a desti: Tafiyar zuwa da dawowa daga wurin farawa zuwa inda za a je a kan titunan da keke zai iya bi (yana fifita hanyoyin keke) tare da batir da aka yi amfani da shi a kan ƙasa, da taswirar nisa ta yadda keken zai je ya dawo ta kowace hanya.
org.mobsimlab.cargo-bike.Yearly cost of the cargo bike against a: Kuɗin shekara na keken kaya idan aka kwatanta da mota don tafiye-tafiye iri ɗaya: saye, makamashi, haraji, inshora, ajiye mota da gyara, a kuɗin ƙasar wurin farawa.

org.mobsimlab.energy.Electricity, diesel, final energy and CO: Wutar lantarki, dizal, makamashin ƙarshe da CO2e a shekara ga kowace layi, kowane nau'in sufuri da hanyar sadarwa baki ɗaya, tare da ƙarfi ga kowace km ta abin hawa da kowace km ta wurin zama.
org.mobsimlab.energy.Traction energy and greenhouse gas emiss: Makamashin jan abin hawa da hayaƙin iskar gas mai ɗumama duniya na kowace layi a shekara, ga kowane nau'in sufuri da hanyar sadarwa, daga km na abin hawa da kowace layi ke yi: wutar lantarki a tashar wuta ko caja, dizal a lita, da CO2e daga ƙarfin hayaƙin layin wutar lantarki da dizal daga rijiya zuwa ƙafa. Ana nuna shi a shafin Teburori.

org.mobsimlab.esri-imagery.Aerial photos at about 0.3 to 1 m per pi: Hotunan sama na kusan mita 0.3 zuwa 1 a kowane pikisel a yawancin birane, marasa kyau a karkara: suna da kyau sosai don ganin layukan mota, gefen titi da layin dogo. Ranakun ɗaukar hotunan sun bambanta bisa wuri.
org.mobsimlab.esri-imagery.Esri World Imagery as an aerial basemap:: Esri World Imagery a matsayin taswirar tushe ta sama: hotunan sama na kusan mita 0.3 zuwa 1 a kowane pikisel a yawancin birane, masu kyau sosai don ganin layukan mota, gefen titi da layin dogo. Ana bayarwa da zarar Mai gudanarwa ya ajiye maɓallin ArcGIS API ya kuma amince da sharuɗɗan Esri a Gudanarwa → Ƙarin manhajoji; tayiloli suna wucewa ta wannan MobSimLab, don haka masu bincike ba sa ganin maɓallin, kuma ba a ajiye su.

org.mobsimlab.ferry.Electric hydrofoil: Jirgin ruwa mai fikafikai na lantarki
org.mobsimlab.ferry.Monohull water bus: Bas ɗin ruwa mai ƙashi ɗaya
org.mobsimlab.ferry.Passenger ferries and water buses drawn: Jiragen ruwa na fasinjoji da bas-bas na ruwa da ake zanawa da kayan aikin hanyar ruwa: tasoshi masu wuraren tsayawa da gadojin hawa, hanyoyi a kan ruwa, yankunan gudu da duba wuraren tsayawa (ADR-0037). Jiragen ruwa masu ɗaukar motoci za su zo daga baya.
org.mobsimlab.ferry.Water buses and crossings: click piers,: Bas-bas na ruwa da ketarewa: danna tasoshi, tsara hanya a kan ruwa.

org.mobsimlab.gtfs.Reads a GTFS feed (zip) into the project: Yana karanta ciyarwar GTFS (zip) cikin aikin a matsayin hanyar sadarwa da ke akwai don rana ɗaya ta sabis, an yanke ta zuwa ganin taswira idan an buƙata, domin mai tsara tafiya ya bi ta tare da layukan da aka tsara; kuma yana rubuta layukan aikin a matsayin ciyarwar GTFS don wasu kayan aiki.
org.mobsimlab.gtfs.Stops, routes and the trips of one servi: Tasoshi, hanyoyi da tafiye-tafiyen rana ɗaya ta sabis (Laraba mafi cunkoso sai dai idan an ba da kwanan wata), tare da frequencies.txt a matsayin tsarin yawan tafiya da nau'ikan hanya a matsayin nau'ikan sufuri.
org.mobsimlab.gtfs.The project's lines as a weekday GTFS fe: Layukan aikin a matsayin ciyarwar GTFS ta ranar aiki: tafiye-tafiye daidai, layukan yawan tafiya a matsayin frequencies.txt, tashoshi don rukunin tasoshi.

org.mobsimlab.nasa-gibs.About 30 m per pixel (38 m on this map),: Kusan mita 30 a kowane pikisel (mita 38 a wannan taswira), daga wucewar tauraron ɗan adam na rana ɗaya: wasu sassan taswirar babu komai ko akwai gajimare, don haka gwada wata rana. Ba su da kyau sosai don zana layin dogo ko gefen titi.
org.mobsimlab.nasa-gibs.Satellite imagery from NASA's Global Ima: Hotunan tauraron ɗan adam daga Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) na NASA a matsayin taswirorin tushe na sama, don ranar da ka zaɓa: Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 na kusan mita 30 a kowane pikisel da VIIRS na kusan mita 250. Ba a buƙatar maɓallin API. Hotunan ba su da kyau sosai don ganin tituna ko layin dogo.
org.mobsimlab.nasa-gibs.The whole world each day at about 250 m: Duniya gaba ɗaya kowace rana a kusan mita 250 a kowane pikisel (mita 306 a wannan taswira), tare da gajimare: don yanayin yanki kawai.

org.mobsimlab.noise.Estimated noise of the service lines (AD: Ƙiyasin hayaniyar layukan sabis (ADR-0038): zirin hayaniya kai tsaye yayin zana layukan titi da layin dogo, tare da duba ƙarar lanƙwasa, gadoji da maɓallan canza hanya. Fitar hayaniyar hanya da layin dogo ta CNOSSOS-EU, a filin buɗaɗɗe ba tare da gine-gine ba a yanzu.
org.mobsimlab.noise.L_den and L_night of the drawn lines at: L_den da L_night na layukan da aka zana a mita 4, filin buɗaɗɗe: nisan zirin a ɓangarorin biyu, grid na masu karɓa don taswira da bincike.

org.mobsimlab.ogc-layers.Map layers from WMS, WMTS and XYZ tile s: Layukan taswira daga sabis-sabis na tayiloli na WMS, WMTS da XYZ, a matsayin taswirorin tushe ko na sama. Mai gudanarwa yana ƙara sabis a Gudanarwa → Ƙarin manhajoji, tare da bayanan shiga idan ana buƙata; tayiloli suna wucewa ta wannan MobSimLab, don haka masu bincike ba sa ganin su.
org.mobsimlab.ogc-layers.WMS, WMTS and XYZ map layers: Layukan taswira na WMS, WMTS da XYZ

org.mobsimlab.on-demand-bus.Demand-responsive transport drawn with t: Sufuri bisa buƙata da ake zanawa da kayan aikin yankin sabis: zana yanki, saita buƙatu a kowace awa, rukunin motoci da lokutan sabis, ka sami motocin da ake buƙata, matsakaicin jira, lokacin tafiya da lokacin ƙofa zuwa ƙofa daga dabarun kimantawa mai ci gaba. Kwaikwayon rana yana tura kowane ajiyar wuri tafiya bayan tafiya (ADR-0042). Yankin yana bayyana a mai tsara tafiya.
org.mobsimlab.on-demand-bus.Minibuses booked by app: outline the zon: Ƙananan bas-bas da ake ajiyewa ta manhaja: zana yankin, saita rukunin motoci da lokuta.

org.mobsimlab.panoramax.Photos shared by people and public bodie: Hotunan da mutane da hukumomin gwamnati suka raba, ƙarƙashin lasisi a buɗe (galibi CC BY-SA 4.0 ko Etalab 2.0) da ke ba da damar zana taswira daga gare su. Ambaci mai hoton idan ka yi amfani da ɗaya.
org.mobsimlab.panoramax.Street-level photos from Panoramax, the: Hotunan matakin titi daga Panoramax, taskar hotunan titi ta jama'a mai 'yanci kuma a buɗe. Buɗe Hotunan titi a kan taswira don ganin inda aka ɗauki hotuna, sannan danna wani wuri don ganin hotunan da aka ɗauka kusa da shi. Hotunan suna ƙarƙashin lasisi a buɗe da ke ba da damar zana taswira daga gare su. Ba a buƙatar maɓalli. Hotunan suna wucewa ta wannan MobSimLab kuma ba a ajiye su ko adana su tare da aikin.
